top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1007(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A current CPR and First Aid needed for primary caregiver.  the cerificates on file expired.

top_violation_types.title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The smoke detector was not working and there was not a smoke detector in the front room.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver had seven students in care ages 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, and 22 months old. The operation was out of ratio by one student.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Emergencies (26 TAC §747.501(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies are missing procedures for handling medical emergencies.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - HS Diploma, Equivalent, or Coursework Completion (26 TAC §747.1207(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The assistant caregiver's file lacked the documentation for qualifications for an assistant caregiver.

top_violation_types.title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Sign in and out logs were not available for review during this inspection.
